body_markdown:
# Black Friday 2026: Exclusive Raycast Pro and Pro+ Offer


30% off Raycast Pro and 15% off Pro+. Expires Dec 1st 2026.


Tirta Wulandari


November 27, 2026


We're excited to announce our **Black Friday 2026 promotion** for Raycast Pro! If you've been waiting for the perfect time to supercharge your productivity, this is it.


## What's the Offer?


New subscribers can enjoy a special Black Friday discount on annual Raycast plans:


- **30% off** annual Individual Pro and Teams Pro plans with code` BFPRO`
- **15% off** annual Individual Pro+ plans with code` BFPROPLUS`


This is our way of welcoming more people to the Raycast community and helping them experience the full power of our productivity platform.


## Why Raycast Pro?


[Raycast Pro](https://www.raycast.com/pro) adds AI, Dictation and Cloud Sync on top of everything you already use for free in Raycast. Here are the features we'd point a friend to first.


### Dictation


Most of what you type, you could say faster. Press your hotkey, speak naturally, and[Dictation](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/dictation) turns your words into clean text in whatever app you're in. Raycast drops the filler words and fixes punctuation, capitalization and grammar along the way, so what lands in the text field reads like you typed it.


With[Auto Styling](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/dictation#auto-styling) , the same thought comes out as a properly formatted email in Mail and a short, casual reply in Slack. You can create your own styles for things like meeting notes or code comments, and teach Dictation the names and terms you use every day. It works on Mac and Windows, and on[iPhone](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/dictation#dictate-on-ios) through the Raycast Keyboard.


### The Raycast Keyboard


On iPhone and iPad, the[Raycast Keyboard](https://manual.raycast.com/ios/keyboard) can now replace your default keyboard. It's a full typing keyboard with autocorrect, swipe typing and emoji, so you don't give anything up. The extras sit one tap above the keys: Quick Fix a message before you send it, ask AI, translate, expand a Snippet, find the right GIF, or dictate with the same styles you set up on your Mac.


No more switching keyboards to get to Raycast. It's there in almost every app you type in.


### Automations and Projects


Raycast AI is a proper agent now. Give[AI Chat](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/ai-chat) a task and it plans, uses your extensions, writes and runs code, checks the results and keeps going until it's done. When something fails, it tries a different approach. When it needs a decision, it stops and asks you.


[Automations](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/automations) let that agent work on a schedule. Write a prompt once and wake up to a plan for the week every Monday, or get a summary of your unread messages every evening.[Projects](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/projects) keep ongoing work in one place, with shared instructions, a memory built from your chats and a working directory on your computer. Every new chat in a project starts with the right context, so you never repeat yourself.


### Everything Else in Pro


Pro comes with plenty more that makes Raycast yours:


- **Raycast AI everywhere** :[Quick AI](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/quick-ai) ,[AI Chat](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/ai-chat) ,[AI Commands](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/ai-commands) and[AI Extensions](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/ai-extensions) , right where you already work
- **Your own AI setup** :[Agents](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/agents) and[Skills](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/skills) tailored to how you work
- **AI that knows you** :[Personalization](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/personalization) with[Profile](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/personalization#profile) and[Memory](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/personalization#memory) , plus[Screen Awareness](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/screen-awareness)
- **Your models, your way** : bring your own[subscription](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/bring-your-own-subscription) or[API key](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/bring-your-own-key) , connect[Custom Providers](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/custom-providers) , or use[local models](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/local-models) and[MCP](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/model-context-protocol)
- [Raycast MCP Server](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/model-context-protocol#raycast-mcp-server) : bring Raycast's AI Extensions, Notes, Snippets, and more into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other AI apps
- **Unlimited[Notes](https://manual.raycast.com/notes)** , synced across all your devices
- [Cloud Sync](https://manual.raycast.com/cloud-sync) across Mac, Windows, iPhone and iPad, plus unlimited[Clipboard History](https://manual.raycast.com/clipboard-history) ,[Translate](https://manual.raycast.com/translate) ,[Custom Themes](https://manual.raycast.com/themes) and[Custom Window Management commands](https://manual.raycast.com/window-management#custom-commands)


## Why Raycast Pro+?


Pro+ adds access to[Flagship AI models](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/ai-credits#top-tier-models) such as Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.2, and GPT-6 Astra on top of everything in Pro, plus[6x the monthly AI credits of the Pro plan](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/ai-credits#monthly-credits) (3,000 vs. 500 credits).


## Why Raycast Teams Pro?


[Raycast Teams Pro](https://www.raycast.com/teams) gives everyone on your team all of Pro, plus shared[Snippets](https://manual.raycast.com/teams/shared-features#snippets) ,[Quicklinks](https://manual.raycast.com/teams/shared-features#quicklinks) ,[AI Commands](https://manual.raycast.com/teams/shared-features#ai-commands) ,[AI Agents](https://manual.raycast.com/teams/shared-features#agents) and[Dictation styles](https://manual.raycast.com/teams/shared-features#dictation-styles) , a[private Store](https://manual.raycast.com/teams/shared-features#extensions) for your team’s own extensions, and[centralized billing](https://manual.raycast.com/billing#raycast-for-teams-pro-pro-max) .


## Who Can Redeem This Offer?


This promotion is **exclusively for new subscribers on annual plans** . The offer is available from **November 27, 2026** , until **December 1, 2026 at 23:59 UTC** .


**Important details:**


- This discount is for new subscriptions only
- Annual billing only, monthly plans are not eligible
- All Max plans and Teams Pro+ are excluded from this promotion
- Not applicable to upgrades on existing subscriptions (e.g. Pro to Pro+)
- Not valid for billing cycle changes on active subscriptions
- Only one promotional code can be used per checkout
- Cannot be combined with other discounts (including student discounts and affiliate program referrals)


## How to Redeem


Redeeming your Black Friday discount is simple:


1. Visit[raycast.com/pricing](https://www.raycast.com/pricing)
2. Confirm Yearly billing is selected
3. On the Pro or Pro+ card, click **Choose Plan**
4. On the checkout page, click **Add promotion code**
5. Paste your code into the input field and click **Apply** :` BFPRO` for individual Pro or Teams Pro,` BFPROPLUS` for individual Pro+


**Important:** Make sure you're not using an affiliate link when checking out, as this will prevent the promo code field from appearing. If you don't see the option to enter a promo code, try opening the checkout page in incognito mode or visit[raycast.com](https://www.raycast.com/) directly.


### Questions?


If you have any questions about this promotion or need assistance with your subscription, our support team is here to help. Email us atbilling@raycast.com .


Don't miss this opportunity to join Raycast Pro at a special price.
